# iced_term 0.8.0

Sources from the [iced_term 0.8.0 Rust crate](https://crates.io/crates/iced_term/0.8.0), MIT licensed. The local changes let the app supply macOS native font metrics, retain fractional logical cell sizes on Retina, center the grid with dynamic padding, and align mouse hit tests with the rendered grid. The local view also distinguishes the `DIM` flag from the combined `DIM_BOLD` mask so plain bold text stays bright. Cursor rendering uses the terminal-provided shape, draws block cursors as cell colors, and enforces contrast against the cell and its glyph. The renderer draws QR half-block and sextant characters directly in the cell grid so they do not depend on font coverage. Wheel input normalizes Retina backing pixels and sends mouse-aware applications wheel reports at the visible cell under the pointer. The terminal emulator remains upstream `alacritty_terminal`.
